reference_opening: Your booking reference is B K number <integer saved counter> confirmed for

rng: Measure upstream CUDA RNG offset stride per connection; restore construction RNG state; advance skipped cached/header and forced-text draws exactly. Observed stride 68 on pinned runtime. No fixed seed or hardcoded stride.

word_pacing: Weekday words5; ordinal date words after English month and before at5; ordinary words/time3; B/K/zero retain existing pace5.
session_seed_policy: None in unseeded acceptance flows; optional initial-connection seed only for declared A/B. No per-tool seed reset.
